source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Στέφανος ο Πρεσβύτερος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole entry is a couplet and one sentence of five words. The day's listing carries a second presbyter on the same day, «Όσιος Άνθιμος ο Πρεσβύτερος» (`/497/`), whose page says the same one thing of him and who already has a folder in the corpus; the two are two men on two pages. The page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and it gives no century and no place, so there is no `dates` object. No hymn is printed.
